product_metadata.title: Ollny Christmas Lights Outdoor Cluster Lights - 400 LED 20ft 4X Bright 8 Modes Memory, Christmas Tree Lights Plug in Waterproof String Lights for Garland Patio Indoor Outside Decorations, Multicolored
features: ✅【Super Bright Christmas Lights】Ollny multi color christmas lights are made of technical led chips and copper wire, super durable, equipped with high-bright mini light beads, bigger and brighter than common cluster lights. These led christmas lights include 20ft/6m length+9.8ft/3m extension cord. Perfect christmas lights for tree, bedroom, living room, patio, tent, or outside yard decoration.

✅【8 Modes&Memory Function】There are 8 lighting modes with our balck wire outdoor christmas lights, which will provide more embellishing ideas for your house decorations. In addition, our white lights can save your last mode without resetting it every day, which is especially convenient.And dimmable brightness(100%,75%, 50%, 25%).

✅【Waterproof Christmas Lights】These cluster christmas lights have a high level of waterproof rated with IP44. So our led string lights will still stay super bright and sparkling even in strong rain, and windy days. Great idea for outdoor decorations.

✅【Remote Control & Timer Function】Ollny christmas indoor lights have 3 timer modes. Different from the traditional white christmas lights, the new indicator is added to quickly adjust. Just short press the button on the remote to switch between different modes to get a pleasant festive atmosphere.

✅【Easy to Install & Safe Certification】Lightweight and durable indoor string lights, easy to hang and twine, can DIY any style you want. Our led christmas tree lights come with UL Listed 29V low-voltage power plug. You can use or touch them outdoor and indoors safely. More safe and less power consumption.
